upstream_source_evidence.transfer_hypothesis: The useful transferable mechanism is a typed temporal/provenance shape over immutable evidence, not Graphiti as a second canonical graph database.

synthetic_cases: Explicit SINGLE supersession: service.mode blue -> green.
MULTI-valued auth.uses: JWT and session_tokens coexist without false supersession.
ALTERNATIVE deployment.region: us-east and eu-west remain contradictory unresolved evidence.
Backdated schema.version validity/reference time remains distinct from later observed_at transaction evidence.

microbenchmark_synthetic_only.warning: Environment-specific synthetic microbenchmark only. It is not an F2 E4 ablation, production benchmark or architecture promotion result.

adjudication.supported: A minimal Graphiti-inspired temporal/provenance projection can be deterministic, rebuildable, source-bound and contradiction-preserving when invalidation occurs only through explicit typed supersession rather than generic same-predicate replacement.
not_supported: No claim that full Graphiti should be imported.
No claim that Neo4j/FalkorDB/Neptune improves F2.
No Graphiti LLM extraction accuracy claim.
No current F2 UnifiedDB runtime comparison.
No causal reasoning, GWT uptake, whole-system or training claim.

counterevidence_and_limits: The fixture reproduces the inspected transferable semantics; it does not import or execute the complete Graphiti package.
The canonical table is synthetic and not the exact current F2 UnifiedDB schema/runtime.
The direct baseline implementation is intentionally naive; timing cannot be promoted as a production speedup.
No independent external replication was performed; deterministic shuffled-order replay is reproducibility evidence only.
Projection value remains unproven against current F2 native retrieval and current Stage-3 memory/context surfaces.
next_exact_action: Only under a separate create-only E4 claim, bind the same typed temporal projection to exact-current F2 UnifiedDB/native retrieval and compare matched historical/current query correctness, contradiction preservation, source/generation deletion-rebuild behavior, storage overhead, p50/p95/p99 latency and implementation complexity. Do not create a second canonical truth store and do not promote on synthetic E3 timing alone.
